title: Thursday off-day carousel: six 4:5 cards on one running stadium scoreboard
goal: Build a six-card 4:5 carousel (1080x1350 each) as code. One visual system across the deck: a stadium scoreboard with lamp-style digits. Card 1 is a full-bleed front cover: a night scene drawn in code, the scoreboard glowing over an empty small-town field, the board reading VOTERS 40, DATA CENTRES 1; the headline below the board at least 1.3 times the body headline size, laid out differently from the body cards. Cards 2 to 5: the headline at the top, then the board as a sourced chart taking at least 40% of the card: card 2 a grid of 41 ballot squares, 40 lit LIMIT and 1 plain; card 3 one bar filled to 43%; card 4 three panels (a big 59, small sites beside a solar field, a phone with a glowing chip); card 5 a two-question checklist. Card 6 is the palette's close: the takeaway headline, the board dimmed, then 'Subscribe free (makeyourmindup.ai)' and the wordmark small bottom right. Write .scratch/carousel/midterms/draw.py that reads every word from a JSON file given as its first argument (keys: cards[].headline, cards[].line, cards[].board, close_cta) and writes .scratch/carousel/midterms/out/card-1.png to card-6.png. Ship .scratch/carousel/midterms/words.sample.json with placeholder words of realistic length, and run draw.py on it.
contract: Outputs: .scratch/carousel/midterms/draw.py, words.sample.json, out/card-{1..6}.png at 1080x1350. Colours and fonts only from the Brand section and config/ve/brand-tokens.json, fonts from the repository's font files, never a system font. Every line of type centred; nothing outside 80 px of every edge; body headline ink at least 35 px tall; no empty band over 12% of the height. No card numbers, no footnotes, source strips, dates or URLs except the close's CTA. No logos, no stock icons, no clipart people. The mark is the official file, never type.
acceptance:
python3 .scratch/carousel/midterms/draw.py .scratch/carousel/midterms/words.sample.json
python3 -c "from PIL import Image; import sys; [sys.exit(1) for n in range(1,7) if Image.open(f'.scratch/carousel/midterms/out/card-{n}.png').size!=(1080,1350)]"
python3 scripts/carousel_check.py --cards .scratch/carousel/midterms/out/card-1.png .scratch/carousel/midterms/out/card-2.png .scratch/carousel/midterms/out/card-3.png .scratch/carousel/midterms/out/card-4.png .scratch/carousel/midterms/out/card-5.png .scratch/carousel/midterms/out/card-6.png
